def _named_modules_with_dup(model: nn.Module, prefix: str='') ->Iterable[Tuple
    [str, nn.Module]]:
    if prefix:
        yield prefix, model
    for name, module in model.named_modules():
        if name:
            full_name = prefix + '.' + name if prefix else name
            yield full_name, module
